subject.title: feat(ios): redesign Control tab to a flatter, card-based layout

question: Should OpenClaw adopt a flat/card-based phone Control tab now that current main has moved toward native SwiftUI List/Form styling?
rationale: The remaining blocker is not only code repair: accepting this PR would choose a new default iPhone Control visual direction that overlaps newer merged design work and the linked issue already carries product-decision labels.

options.title: Continue only after rebase and proof
options.body: Have the contributor rebase onto the current native Control hub, fix branded typography, add real before/after simulator proof, and then review the design against the current iOS direction.

options.title: Close in favor of native direction
options.body: If maintainers prefer the merged stock SwiftUI List/Form direction, close this PR and the paired feature issue with that design rationale.

options.title: Park for later design review
options.body: Leave the PR and issue open until a maintainer chooses the broader iOS Control tab direction, without queuing automated repair work.

recommendation.title: Continue only after rebase and proof
recommendation.body: Have the contributor rebase onto the current native Control hub, fix branded typography, add real before/after simulator proof, and then review the design against the current iOS direction.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the most directly overlapping merged Control/Talk visual hierarchy work and are the best available routing candidate for the design-direction choice.
